ev.q: In 2008, 75% of all U.S. children aged <6 years (approximately 18 million children) participated in an IIS.
Of the 52 responding grantees, 22 grantees (42%) reported that >95% of children aged <6 years participated in the IIS
Nationally, 95 million persons of all ages (33% of the U.S. population) were participating in an IIS in 2008.
To monitor progress toward this goal, CDC annually surveys immunization grantees
From 2006 to 2008, participation increased from 65% to 75%.
The 2008 IISAR, a self-administered, Internet-based questionnaire

methods_quotes.q: was calculated by dividing the number of children aged <6 years participating in the IIS by the 2008 mid-year U.S. Census projection
to determine the proportion that are >90% complete in IIS records.
Calculated by number of data field completions in IIS records and the overall number of IIS records.
